text.formatted: The worg has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked Prone.
